name: Innkeeper Keldamyr
summary: In Dolanaar, Innkeeper Keldamyr offers food, drink, and a place to rest. Young night elves leaving Shadowglen can find shelter at his inn beneath the boughs of the World Tree.

sections.title: Hearth of Dolanaar
sections.body: Dolanaar is the first village many newcomers reach after leaving the sheltered glade of Aldrassil. At the village's central inn, Innkeeper Keldamyr offers bread, spring water, and soft beds beneath Teldrassil's canopy. Travelers, sentinels, and young novices bound for Darnassus pause at his counter to rest, bind their Hearthstones, and gather rations for the journey through the boughs.

sections.title: Town Deliveries
sections.body: An inn high among the branches depends on steady supplies from nearby settlements and tradesfolk. Couriers bringing goods are often sent to Keldamyr's desk, tying his inn to the daily trade that keeps Dolanaar running.

faq.q: Where can I find Innkeeper Keldamyr?
faq.answer: You can find Keldamyr inside the main inn at the heart of Dolanaar, the first major settlement south of Shadowglen on Teldrassil's boughs.

faq.q: What services does Innkeeper Keldamyr offer?
faq.answer: Keldamyr offers food, drink, and a place to rest. You can bind your Hearthstone at his hearth, buy water, milk, juice, and bread, or log out rested beneath his roof.
Keldamyr receives parcels for the inn through the local courier task called 'Dolanaar Delivery.'

angles.text: As a night elf leaving Shadowglen's training grounds, you can make Keldamyr's inn your first home away from home and bind your Hearthstone there.
